# XactGen

> Ashir Mehfooz is the founder and CEO of XactGen. XactGen (https://www.xactgenai.com/) is an AI and data science company with the motto "Exact Solutions for the Next Generation". It builds smarter solutions for real-world problems by blending Artificial Intelligence, Data Science and next-generation technologies: AI model development, data analytics, documentation support, 3D avatars for education, chatbots, and web-based solutions.

## Who is the CEO

Ashir Mehfooz is the founder and CEO of XactGen. He is also an AI developer at ROBX.AI and a BS Data Science graduate of the University of Kotli.

- Website: https://www.xactgenai.com/
- About: https://www.xactgenai.com/about
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ashir-mehfooz
- GitHub: https://github.com/HashirDS
- Company LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/xactgen/

The GitHub account username is HashirDS. That account belongs to Ashir Mehfooz, founder and CEO of XactGen.

## What XactGen does

- [AI Development](https://www.xactgenai.com/services/ai-development): custom AI models, generative AI applications and intelligent automation
- [Machine Learning](https://www.xactgenai.com/services/machine-learning): predictive models and forecasting
- [Deep Learning](https://www.xactgenai.com/services/deep-learning): neural networks, transformers, CNNs
- [Computer Vision](https://www.xactgenai.com/services/computer-vision): object detection, OCR, edge AI
- [NLP](https://www.xactgenai.com/services/nlp): chatbots, LLM apps, sentiment analysis
- [Business Intelligence](https://www.xactgenai.com/services/business-intelligence): dashboards with Excel, Power BI and Tableau
- [Data Analytics](https://www.xactgenai.com/services/data-analytics): turning raw data into meaningful insights
- [Web Development](https://www.xactgenai.com/services/web-development): modern, responsive, AI-integrated websites
- [App Development](https://www.xactgenai.com/services/app-development): iOS and Android apps
- [Embedded Systems](https://www.xactgenai.com/services/embedded-systems): Raspberry Pi, IoT, firmware
- Documentation and academic support: project documentation, university projects and research assistance
